quick_links.title: Project portfolio
quick_links.desc: These charts group local projects by status and game so you can decide what to work on next.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.desc: The sidebar groups work by Projects, Translation Workflow, and Quality & Terminology, while Task Center keeps active work and items needing attention.

tutorial_btn.title: Tutorial Guide
tutorial_btn.desc: Click this button to reopen the tutorial for the current page at any time.

settings_link.title: System Settings
settings_link.desc: Crucial: Head here to configure your API keys and customize the workbench theme.

search.title: Power Search
search.desc: Global search across files and games to locate any term instantly.

files.title: Glossary Files
files.desc: Manage glossary files for different games on the left.

table.title: Entry Management
table.desc: Edit source text, translations, and variants here. Changes are saved to SQLite instantly.

list.title: Project List
list.desc: View and manage all your localization projects here.

create.title: Start from Scratch
create.desc: Create your first translation project. Ensure your API Key is ready in Settings -> API before starting.

new_task.title: New Task
new_task.desc: Create file-based tasks or even just custom notes for your mod.

stats.title: Project Overview
stats.desc: Quickly check total files, lines, and the percentage of translation and proofreading progress.

start.title: Key Action: Start Translation
start.desc: When everything is ready, click this button to enter the translation configuration and start the AI-powered process.

paths.title: Path Management
paths.desc: Configure source and export paths for each specific Mod.

tabs.title: Task Board
tabs.desc: Navigate between file overview and the Kanban board for visual task management.

validation_tab.title: Format Validation Tab
validation_tab.desc: Use this tab to check Paradox localization formatting, variables, and keys after translation.

history_tab.title: Project History Tab
history_tab.desc: Use this tab to review archive baselines, uploaded translations, and version events before incremental updates.

validation_scope.title: Format Checks Only
validation_scope.desc: This page only checks Paradox script formatting issues such as variables, tags, line breaks, and localization key names. It does not judge wording quality or style.

validation_workshop.title: Open Format Repair
validation_workshop.desc: Format Repair can automatically detect malformed keys such as [concept】, $key￥, or [概念2], then use AI to repair them back into valid forms like [concept], $key$, and [concept2].

history_overview.title: Archive And Version Timeline
history_overview.desc: History records the project archive baseline, upload/build timestamps, and major version events. This is the staging area you use before incremental updates.

history_upload.title: Upload Existing Translations
history_upload.desc: Use this to archive translations that already exist on disk into the project database. If you received a half-finished mod from someone else, this should usually be your first step before incremental update.

history_incremental.title: Go To Incremental Update
history_incremental.desc: Incremental update compares the newly updated source files against this archived baseline, reuses unchanged translations, and only sends the changed or new entries back through the translation workflow.

select.title: Select Project
select.desc: Please select a project to begin the translation process.

config.title: Configure Translation
config.desc: Set up your source/target languages and choosing an AI model.

start.title: Start Batch
start.desc: Click this to begin the automated translation batch.

processing.title: Processing
processing.desc: The AI is now translating your files. You can watch the real-time logs here.

mod_select.title: Module Selection
mod_select.desc: Switch between different mods to proofread their contents.

editor.title: Triple-Column Editor
editor.desc: Compare original, AI draft, and final edit side-by-side with real-time sync.

validate.title: Integrity Check
validate.desc: Run automated checks for missing tags, broken variables, or inconsistent terminology.

select.title: Pick the Existing Project
select.desc: Incremental translation starts from an existing archived project. Search for the project you want to update here.

project_cards.title: Project Cards
project_cards.desc: Choose the project whose archive and history should be reused as the comparison baseline.

setup.title: Archive and Path Setup
setup.desc: This step checks archive availability, lets you choose target languages, and points the workflow at the new source folder.

languages.title: Target Languages
languages.desc: Only archived target languages can be updated incrementally. Pick one or more languages to rebuild.

folder.title: Updated Source Folder
folder.desc: Point this to the new mod folder or workshop copy that contains the latest source files.

workshop.title: Embedded Format Repair
workshop.desc: Keep this enabled if you want one automatic validation-and-fix pass after translation completes.

prescan.title: Run the Pre-scan
prescan.desc: Pre-scan compares old and new sources first, so you can inspect the scope before spending API calls.

summary.title: Pre-scan Summary
summary.desc: Review reused, changed, and new entries here. This is the last checkpoint before the real run.

start.title: Start Incremental Translation
start.desc: Launch the actual incremental run once the counts and provider settings look correct.

execution.title: Execution and Logs
execution.desc: Watch runtime progress, warnings, and log output while the incremental workflow is rebuilding files.

results.title: Final Output
results.desc: After completion, check warnings, exported workshop issues, and the output folder path here.

select.title: Select a Project to Repair
select.desc: Format Repair works against an existing project. Use search and filters to find the target project first.

project_cards.title: Project Candidates
project_cards.desc: Pick the project whose validation issues you want to scan and repair.

summary.title: Project Context
summary.desc: Review archive state, source language, and recent translation context before starting the scan.

scan.title: Scan for Issues
scan.desc: This starts the Format Repair scan. If this project already has a saved issue record, the program loads it directly so you do not have to rescan everything.

fix_settings.title: Fix Strategy
fix_settings.desc: Choose the provider, model, batch size, concurrency, and RPM before launching automated fixes.

issue_details.title: Issue Review
issue_details.desc: Inspect grouped file issues here, or open single-item fixes if you want to review them one by one.

start.title: Start Batch Repair
start.desc: Launch the automated repair pass after you are satisfied with the scan results and model settings.

execution.title: Repair Progress
execution.desc: Track the repair run, progress percentage, and worker logs while fixes are being generated.

results.title: Diff Preview
results.desc: Review before/after suggestions here once the run completes, then decide what to keep.

prompt.message: Create or select a publishing workspace first, then prepare its cover, description, and adopted version.

overview.title: Publishing workspaces
overview.desc: Steam Workshop stores local publishing assets only. It does not upload or change Steam content.

workspace.title: Create or bind a workspace
workspace.desc: Create a workspace for a Remis project, or leave it independent. A Workshop ID is optional until a real upload exists.

enter.title: Enter a workspace
enter.desc: Open a workspace to prepare its cover, Workshop description, and version history together.

sections.title: Three publishing areas
sections.desc: Use Cover for image composition, Description for BBCode, and Version History to inspect or adopt saved candidates.

cover.title: Compose the cover
cover.desc: Add a project thumbnail, flags, text, or emblems. Downloading is local only; save a candidate version when the design is ready.

cover_versions.title: Save a reusable cover version
cover_versions.desc: A saved cover keeps both the editable canvas and exported PNG. Later choose the candidate in Version History.

description.title: Write and preview BBCode
description.desc: Edit BBCode here, check the safe preview, and save it as a candidate. Model generation requires a Workshop ID and explicit approval.

history.title: Inspect and adopt versions
history.desc: Filter cover and description candidates, open their content, then explicitly set one as adopted. Adoption never uploads to Steam.

auto_start_prompt.title: Quick Start
auto_start_prompt.message: It seems it's your first time here. Would you like a quick tour?

general.title: General Settings
general.desc: Switch languages and basic configuration items.

theme.title: Aesthetic Selection
theme.desc: Switch between carefully crafted themes. Each theme changes the entire workbench vibe, from fonts to textures.

api.title: API Configuration Dashboard
api.desc: Here you can manage all AI service providers. Click the 'Configure' button on each card to start.

api_guide.title: Getting Started: What is an API Key?
api_guide.desc:
An API Key is your passport to AI services. Without it, the software cannot function.

Video Tutorials:
Please click the buttons below to watch the tutorial videos on YouTube.

Note: These videos are not created by the author and may be outdated.

api_regions.title: Regions & Security Warnings
api_regions.desc: Protect your Key! Never share it publicly. Usage typically incurs costs. Choose based on your region: International (OpenAI/Gemini), China (DeepSeek), or Local (Ollama).

api_provider.title: Configure Provider
api_provider.desc: Click the 'Configure' button to enter your API key and select your default translation model (e.g., gemini-3-flash-preview). Remember to click Save after entering your API key.

api_cost.title: Cost Efficiency & Quota
api_cost.desc: For most translation tasks, there's no need to use flagship models; cost-effective models are sufficient. We also limit the 'thinking' quota to reduce API costs.

version.title: Version & Feedback
version.desc: Here you can check the version, open the logs folder, or visit the GitHub Issue tracker. We welcome feature requests and bug reports (please attach logs).

tabs.title: Toolbox Tabs
tabs.desc: Switch between different tools like Thumbnail Generator, Workshop Description Generator, etc.

canvas.title: Design Canvas
canvas.desc: Your main workspace. You can drag and drop a background image here to start.

toolbox.title: Generator Toolbox
toolbox.desc: Just a few clicks to easily add flags or languages to an original cover, transforming it into a proper translation mod cover.

drag.title: Drag to Upload
drag.desc: Drag and drop to upload a background image, and you can also upload and overlay custom logos on top of it.

translation_page.embedded_workshop_enabled_desc: Enabled by default. After translation finishes, the workflow runs one automatic format-fixing pass and refreshes the validation result.
translation_page.embedded_workshop_settings_desc: Collapsed by default. Expand to fine-tune proofreading settings separately from translation.
translation_page.embedded_workshop_follow: Follow the current translation API and model by default
translation_page.embedded_workshop_follow_desc: Disable this if you want separate proofreading settings, such as a larger model for translation and a smaller one for proofreading.

translation_page.embedded_workshop_custom_summary: Currently using a dedicated proofreading setup: {{provider}} / {{model}}
translation_page.translation_batch_size_desc: Only applies to this translation run. Auto uses the current provider default.
translation_page.translation_batch_size_tooltip: Controls how many text entries are sent to the AI in each batch. Smaller batches are steadier; larger batches are usually faster. Only applies to this translation run. Unless you have a clear translation bottleneck or really know what you are doing, Auto is the right choice.
translation_page.translation_concurrency_desc: Only applies to this translation run. Auto follows the current built-in strategy.
translation_page.translation_concurrency_tooltip: Controls how many translation batches are sent to the AI at the same time. Lower values are safer for local models. Only applies to this translation run. Unless you have a clear translation bottleneck or really know what you are doing, Auto is the right choice. When Auto is used, local models still fall back to lower concurrency automatically.
translation_page.translation_rpm_desc: Only applies to this translation run. The default keeps the current system pacing.
translation_page.translation_rpm_tooltip: Limits requests per minute for this run to reduce rate limits or local service overload. Unless you have a clear translation bottleneck or really know what you are doing, keep the default value.
translation_page.embedded_workshop_batch_size_tooltip: Controls how many issues Format Repair tries to fix in each batch. Only applies to this run. Unless you have a clear translation bottleneck or really know what you are doing, keep the default value.
translation_page.embedded_workshop_batch_size_desc: Only applies to this translation run. Smaller batches are steadier when the issues are complex.
translation_page.embedded_workshop_concurrency_tooltip: Controls how many Format Repair fix batches run at the same time. Only applies to this run. Unless you have a clear translation bottleneck or really know what you are doing, keep the default value.
translation_page.embedded_workshop_concurrency_desc: Only applies to this translation run. Lower values are safer for local models.
translation_page.embedded_workshop_rpm_tooltip: Limits Format Repair requests per minute for this run to avoid rate limits or local service overload. Unless you have a clear translation bottleneck or really know what you are doing, keep the default value.
translation_page.embedded_workshop_rpm_desc: Only applies to this translation run. The default keeps the current system pacing.

model_arena.subtitle: Compare 2 or 3 models on representative samples from this Mod, vote blind, then reveal preference and format-safety evidence.
model_arena.setup_description: Remis will sample several localization entries from the selected Mod for comparison. No model is called until you start the comparison.
model_arena.contestants_hint: Choose 2 or 3 distinct provider and model combinations.
model_arena.use_project_context: Use the initial-translation glossary stack (main + project) and current Mod context
model_arena.setup_validation: Choose a project, target language, and 2 or 3 distinct configured models.
model_arena.draft_summary: {{count}} samples from {{eligible}} eligible entries · about {{calls}} model requests
model_arena.batch_request_explanation: Each model receives one batch request containing all {{samples}} samples; {{models}} models mean approximately {{models}} requests.
model_arena.glossary_snapshot_summary: {{glossaries}} glossaries mounted with {{entries}} entries; these samples match {{matches}} glossary terms.
model_arena.glossary_snapshot_empty: No glossary is mounted for this run. Models will choose proper-name and terminology translations themselves.
model_arena.identity_hidden: Model identity, format errors, and latency stay hidden until all votes are complete.
model_arena.cost_description: This run compares {{models}} models on {{samples}} samples in approximately {{calls}} requests.
model_arena.cost_unknown: Cloud calls may incur fees; Remis cannot reliably estimate the cost. Local models may take longer. Failed models are never silently replaced.
model_arena.cost_confirm: I approve these model calls and understand they may incur fees.
model_arena.retry_cost_description: Only {{models}} failed models will be retried on the same {{samples}} samples, in approximately {{calls}} requests. Successful models will not be called again.
model_arena.running_description: Every contestant receives the same frozen samples and production prompt.
model_arena.background_notice: This run continues in the background. You may leave and return from Arena history.
model_arena.partial_failed_description: Available evidence has been preserved. Retrying only failed contestants requires another explicit model-call confirmation.
model_arena.voting_description: Judge the translation itself; model identity and validation data are still hidden.
model_arena.unjudgeable_description: Fewer than two usable outputs are available, so this sample can be marked unable to compare.
model_arena.note_description: Included in the default evidence export after redaction.
model_arena.votes_complete_description: You have judged all {{count}} samples. Revealing locks the votes and shows model identities and format evidence.
model_arena.no_samples: This run has no samples to compare.
model_arena.results_description: These results describe this Mod, language direction, prompt, and small sample—not a global model ranking.
model_arena.share_invite: Share your Arena results and help Remis improve
model_arena.history_description: Past comparisons are stored independently from task-log retention.
model_arena.history_empty_description: Completed and in-progress comparisons will appear here.
model_arena.delete_description: This permanently removes its samples, outputs, votes, and independent evidence log.
model_arena.evidence_description: Includes prompts, source and translated text, pre-parse completion text, user notes, safe configuration, usage, hashes, votes, and errors. Secrets, accounts, API URLs, keys, and paths are excluded or redacted.
model_arena.summary_description: Excludes Mod text, prompts, completions, and notes; keeps hashes and aggregate diagnostics.
model_arena.error_generic: The model arena request failed. Please retry.
